who.heading: We are Progress Now
who.p1: In our community, we’re on the frontlines of fascism. We have billionaires in our backyard, ICE in our neighborhoods, and jobs that leave us overworked and underpaid.
who.p2: But it doesn’t have to stay that way.
who.p3:
Together, we’re building working class power on multiple fronts so that every person in our community can live a life with dignity, respect, and solidarity. Organizing our workplaces and organizing our community to make sure our future is for workers and by workers. A better world is possible.
We’re gonna win.
